name: Retro Wood
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: Colours of an old woodblock print: Kanagawa's lotus paper by day and the deep ink of the wave at night, indigo and violet headings, a red bold and soft green strings. On the Kanagawa palette.

zh.description: 温暖复古：褪色的奶油色页和深木色页，六级标题各有颜色，橙色引用，金色粗体。基于 gruvbox 配色。
